capabilities: Run one local Codex app-server process over stdio
Expose a versioned API for text and image tasks
Keep persistent Codex threads across requests
Stream progress and partial response text to callers
Allow or block MCP servers and Codex apps for full access
disambiguation: Not an AI chat or agent plugin itself; it provides no user-facing interface and only serves an API to other plugins.
extras: Desktop only. Tested against Codex CLI 0.162.0-alpha.2; the app-server API can change and incompatible versions error out. Settings UI is English and Russian. Documentation includes SECURITY.md and full types in src/api.ts. Local server execution still uses the upstream Codex service, subject to account model availability and usage limits.
problem: Obsidian plugins that want Codex text or image results have no shared way to start, sign in to, and manage a single local Codex server process.

relations.evidence: Consumers such as the Readwise Reading Tracker or Daily Infographic then find the bridge automatically

summary: Bridge plugin that runs one local Codex app-server process and exposes a versioned API for other plugins to run text and image tasks.
